name: @pipeworx/mcp-bioportal

tools.name: bioportal_search
tools.description: Search ~1,300 biomedical ontologies for a term and get back the matching classes with their preferred label, synonyms, definition, ontology and permanent class IRI. AUTHORITATIVE for mapping free text to a coded clinical concept (NCIT, SNOMEDCT, LOINC, RXNORM, MESH, HPO, ICD10CM) — these are the curated terminologies themselves, not a description of them. Restrict with `ontologies` when you know which vocabulary you want.

ontologies.description: Comma-separated ontology acronyms to restrict to (e.g. "NCIT,DOID,SNOMEDCT")

require_definitions.description: Only return classes that carry a definition

_apiKey.description: Your own BioPortal API key (free, https://bioportal.bioontology.org/accounts/new). Optional — without one the call uses a shared key that NCBO rate-limits across all of its users.

tools.name: bioportal_ontologies
tools.description: List the biomedical ontologies BioPortal carries — acronym, full name and type — so you can pick the right vocabulary acronym before searching or looking up a class. AUTHORITATIVE catalogue of what is available in BioPortal. Pass `filter` to narrow by acronym or name substring.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring of the acronym or name (e.g. "snomed", "cancer")

_apiKey.description: Your own BioPortal API key (free, https://bioportal.bioontology.org/accounts/new). Optional — without one the call uses a shared key that NCBO rate-limits across all of its users.

tools.name: bioportal_class
tools.description: Full record for one ontology class by its IRI — preferred label, every synonym, the curated definition, semantic types, obsolescence flag, and links to parents and children. AUTHORITATIVE for the canonical meaning of a coded concept. Pass the ontology acronym and the class IRI exactly as bioportal_search returned it.

class_id.description: Full class IRI as returned by bioportal_search, e.g. "http://ncicb.nci.nih.gov/xml/owl/EVS/Thesaurus.owl#C3224"

_apiKey.description: Your own BioPortal API key (free, https://bioportal.bioontology.org/accounts/new). Optional — without one the call uses a shared key that NCBO rate-limits across all of its users.

tools.name: bioportal_mappings
tools.description: Cross-ontology mappings for one class — the equivalent concepts in every other BioPortal ontology, with the mapping source (SAME_URI, LOOM, CUI, REST). AUTHORITATIVE for translating a code between terminologies, e.g. an NCIT concept to its SNOMEDCT, MESH and ICD10CM equivalents. Pass the ontology acronym and class IRI.

ontology.description: Ontology acronym the class lives in (e.g. "NCIT")

to_ontology.description: Optional: only mappings into this ontology acronym (e.g. "SNOMEDCT")

_apiKey.description: Your own BioPortal API key (free, https://bioportal.bioontology.org/accounts/new). Optional — without one the call uses a shared key that NCBO rate-limits across all of its users.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bioportal forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bioportal pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
